IANA 时区名,如 Asia/Shanghai。cron 和 {date} 按: An IANA time zone name, like Asia/Shanghai. Cron and {date} use it; without one, this host's time zone is used.
webhook 地址应以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。: The webhook URL should start with http:// or https://.
上一步的输出从标准输入读到。: It reads the previous step's output on standard input.
不填时在这个任务的状态目录里运行,它跨次运行保留。: Without one, it runs in this task's state folder, which is kept across runs.
五段:分 时 日 月 周,按下面的时区;没填时区就按这台主机的。: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday, in the time zone below, or this host's if none is set.
仅有结果时,失败不发: Only with a result, not on failure
令牌无效,请重新填写。: The token is invalid. Enter it again.
列出 {last_run} 之后的新 issue,按 bug、需求、提问分类。只: List the new issues since {last_run}, sorted into bugs, feature requests and questions. Read only; don't reply to any issue.
删除 {host} 上的任务 {name}?运行记录会保留。: Delete task {name} on {host}? Its runs are kept.
删除主机 {name} 的登记?那台主机上的任务不受影响。: Remove host {name}? Its tasks aren't affected.
删除任务 {name}?运行记录会保留。: Delete task {name}? Its runs are kept.
原定时间过去不超过这么久才补跑。: A missed run is caught up only if no more than this much time has passed.
原样交给下一步,可以写要求或固定的说明。: Passed to the next step as is, for instructions or fixed notes.
只在宽限时间内补跑: Run it only within a grace period
只对这台设备上的这个窗口或浏览器生效。: Applies only to this window or browser on this device.
只有在这台主机本机打开的面板才能管理其他主机。: Other hosts can only be managed from the panel opened on this machine itself.
可以使用 {date}、{time}、{datetime}、{last_run}: You can use {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {last_run} (the time of the last successful run), {task_name}, {run_dir} and {state_dir} (a folder kept across runs).
可以修改工作目录里的文件: May change files in the working directory
后面的步骤用 {steps.<名称>.output} 引用它的输出。: Later steps refer to its output with {steps.<name>.output}.
在那台主机上执行 bugu token create <名字> 得到。: Get one by running bugu token create <name> on that host.
失败时,或成功且有输出时: On failure, or on success with output
字母、数字、- 和 _,创建后不能修改。: Letters, digits, - and _. Can't be changed later.
对所有窗口、菜单栏和系统通知生效。命令行用 --lang 单独指定。: Applies to every window, the menu bar and system notifications. The command line uses --lang instead.
无内容:第 {n} 步声明无事可做,后面没有继续,也没有发通知: No content: step {n} said there was nothing to do, so later steps didn't run and no notification was sent
无内容:脚本声明无事可做,后面没有继续,也没有发通知: No content: the script said there was nothing to do, so nothing else ran and no notification was sent
无内容:输出里有静默标记,没有发通知: No content: the output has the silent marker, so no notification was sent
正在运行,结束后才能再次运行。: Running now; it can run again once this run ends.
每周至少选一天。: Choose at least one day of the week.
每次在原定时间前后这么多分钟内随机触发,不总在同一时刻;{date} 等仍按原定: Each run starts at a random time up to this many minutes before or after the scheduled time, so it isn't always the same minute; {date} and the like still use the scheduled time.
每行一个 名=值,用来放密钥,不写进任务定义。其中的值在输出和通知里会被隐藏。: One NAME=VALUE per line, for secrets that stay out of the task definition. Its values are hidden in outputs and notifications.
没有名为 {name} 的任务,可能已被删除。: There is no task named {name}. It may have been deleted.
没有未读的结果。任务有了新结果或失败时会出现在这里。: No unread results. New results and failures of your tasks show up here.
没有用到 {prev} 时,上一步的输出附在提示词后面。: Unless the prompt uses {prev}, the previous step's output is appended to it.
没有这一天的月份不运行,比如 2 月没有 30 号。: Months without this day are skipped, e.g. February has no 30th.
环境变量(可选,每行一个 名=值): Environment variables (optional, one NAME=VALUE per line)
环境变量应写成 名=值,这一行不是:{line}: Environment variables should be NAME=VALUE; this line isn't: {line}
电脑睡眠或关机跨过了原定时间,醒来以后怎么办。: What to do when the computer slept or was off at the scheduled time.
登记另一台主机上的布谷,就能在这个窗口里打开它的面板。: Register Bugu on another host to open its panel in this window.
粘贴这台主机的访问令牌。本机的令牌保存在数据目录的 {file} 文件里,默认是: Paste this host's access token. On this machine it's in the {file} file of the data directory, {path} by default.
系统通知由桌面应用发出。失败和结果可以分开:比如系统通知只管失败,结果用 web: System notifications come from the desktop app. Failures and results can be split: for example, system notifications only for failures and results sent elsewhere by webhook.
请填写脚本文件的路径。: Enter the path of the script file.
请填写补跑的宽限时长。: Enter the grace period for missed runs.
超过后终止并记为超时。: Stopped and marked as timed out after this.
输出包含这段文字时,本次记为无内容,不发通知。比如让 AI 在没有新内容时只输出: When the output contains this text, the run counts as having no content and sends no notification. For example, have the AI print only NOTHING_NEW when there's nothing new.
运行时没有人在场,除非任务确实需要修改文件,否则保持只读。: Nobody is around while it runs. Keep it read-only unless the task really needs to change files.
运行结束后向这个地址 POST 一段 JSON。失败会自动重试。: After each run, a JSON body is POSTed to this URL. Failures are retried automatically.
还没有任务。点\"新建任务\",让一条命令、一个脚本或一个 AI 命令行按时运行: No tasks yet. Choose "New task" to run a command, a script or an AI CLI on a schedule.
还没有结果。任务有了新结果或失败时会出现在这里。: No results yet. New results and failures of your tasks show up here.
这一步最长运行时间,分钟(可选): Time limit for this step in minutes (optional)
这台主机上已配置的 AI 命令行。能否启动可用 bugu runner chec: AI CLIs configured on this host. Check that they start with bugu runner check.
这台主机上没有可用的运行器。: No runners are available on this host.
这是公网上的明文 HTTP 地址:令牌和任务内容会以明文经过网络。建议放在提供: This is a plain HTTP address on the public internet: the token and task contents cross the network unencrypted. Put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS, or use a private address from a mesh network.
连不上后台,它可能已经停止。: Can't reach the backend. It may have stopped.
连不上这台主机,等它恢复在线再打开。: Can't reach this host; open it once it's back online.
那台主机上布谷的地址,如 https://bugu.example.com 或: The address of Bugu on that host, like https://bugu.example.com or http://100.64.0.8:7377.
那台主机拒绝了这个令牌,删除后用新令牌重新登记。: That host rejected the token; delete it and register again with a new token.
随机偏移应是不小于 0 的分钟数。: The random offset should be a number of minutes, 0 or more.
